title: Building Patience (Sabr)
description: Sabr (patience): its meaning, its types, and how to apply it in hardship, worship and human relationships - from the Qur'an, Sunnah and understanding of the Salaf. Lessons from Abu Khadeejah (Forgotten Light and al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures) and AMAU Academy (Prophet Ayyub's story, and stories from the golden generations).
short_description: Sabr: the lost treasure - understanding patience in Islam

modules.title: Understanding Sabr
modules.description: What sabr means: its types and its immense rewards.

lessons.title: Patience upon the Pre-Decree That Causes Distress — Abu Khadeejah
lessons.content: Sabr on qadr that hurts: how to face what Allah sends and remain pleased with Him. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani
